evidence.summary: Header comment states cookie sessions and that every post waits for a moderator.
POST /api/login checks credentials via db.users.check and stores userId in req.session.
GET /api/posts/:id behind requireSession returns a post {id: uuid, body, status}.
POST /api/posts behind requireSession creates a post for the session user, 201, status pending.
GET /api/moderation behind requireModerator lists pending posts.
POST /api/moderation/:id behind requireModerator sets post status from req.body.decision.
users table: uuid id, unique email, display_name, role in (member, moderator).
posts table: uuid id, author_id not null FK users, body <= 5000, status pending/published/rejected default pending, created_at.
requireSession and requireModerator are used but not defined in the folder; their behaviour is inferred from their names.

frontend: JavaScript client with a route table (framework unknown)
database: SQL with uuid and timestamptz types (PostgreSQL-like)

architecture.frontend: client-side route table mapping paths to screens
architecture.backend: single Express-style module exporting route registrations; db access layer not in the folder

features.name: Email sign-in with cookie session
features.description: Members and moderators sign in; the server keeps the user id in a cookie session.
features.observed_behaviour: POST /api/login calls db.users.check(body) and sets req.session.userId, returns {ok: true}.
features.business_logic: Credential check is in db.users.check (not in the folder); password storage unknown.
features.integration: needs session middleware and a users store

features.name: Read a post
features.description: A signed-in user opens a single post by id.
features.observed_behaviour: GET /api/posts/:id behind requireSession returns {id, body, status}.
features.business_logic: Whether pending/rejected posts are hidden from non-authors is not shown.

features.name: Create a post (pending until moderated)
features.description: A signed-in member writes a post of up to 5000 characters; it is stored as pending.
features.observed_behaviour: POST /api/posts creates a post for the session user and returns 201 with status pending.
features.business_logic: Body max 5000 chars (constant and DB check); status default pending; author required.

features.name: Moderation queue
features.description: Moderators list pending posts and publish or reject each.
features.observed_behaviour: GET /api/moderation lists pending posts; POST /api/moderation/:id sets status from a decision field. Both require the moderator role.
features.business_logic: Post status pending -> published | rejected; only role moderator; decision values constrained by DB check only (no visible server validation).

features.name: Post list screen
features.observed_behaviour: Only the client route is present; no list endpoint exists in routes.js.
